question: What is the full form of COBOL?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Common Business-Oriented Language.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **COBOL**

 
 
• **COBOL** stands for **Common Business-Oriented Language. **
 
• It is a **60-year-old** programming language that is still widely used today. 
 
• It was developed in **1959** by **CODASYL (Conference/Committee on Data Systems Languages).**
 
• It is an English-like computer programming language used for business.
 
• The syntax was developed to be simple and explicit.
 
• The non-programmers in business environments could understand it without needing extensive knowledge of coding.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• COBOL has strict rules regarding syntax and organization.
 
• The code for a program written in COBOL is broken up into divisions.
 
• It make it easy to locate and understand the individual components.
 
• Each program consists of four divisions:
 
 
• **Identification division **
 
• **Environment division**
 
• **Data division **
 
• **Procedure division**
